_note: Sourced (see each region's sources): daily traffic (Caltrans AADT, retrieved 2026-10-16); mortality; species and protection status; SR-152 existing_crossings (Pathways for Wildlife 2023); linkage names (I-15: 2023 I-15 wildlife crossing design report; SR-152: Pathways for Wildlife 2023; SR-37: USGS); lanes for I-15 (10, UC Davis 2014) and SR-37 (2: one lane each way between SR 121 and Mare Island, Caltrans). Null because no source counts them: I-15 and SR-37 existing_crossings. Illustrative placeholders: connectivity_score, habitat_patch_ha, barrier_type, SR-152 lanes, and the species habitat descriptions. Map: highways are simplified OpenStreetMap traces (the route lists in this file are rough fallbacks the API replaces); habitat zones are hand-placed circles; I-15's plateau circle, obstruction zone and movement arrows are hand-drawn illustrations; proposed crossing points are concepts, not surveyed sites. US-101: traffic (Caltrans), the elk detection plan (Coastal Commission, Caltrans) and 4 CHP-logged elk collisions are sourced; fields with no source are null. SR-152: Black Bear is a hackathon prompt species but was not recorded in the 2021-2022 Pathways for Wildlife study, so it is not used in the analysis.
